page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, page number at top right, one column of verse and running text below, with a signature mark "P. j." at the lower right of the text block. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Et paulò pòst de hostium suorum multitudine & animositate loquens, dicit,

l.i: Me in vna vocibus tuis fretus fuit,

page.notes: The line "Me ... vna vocibus tuis fretus fuit" is partly illegible in the scan; the second half of the last line is read with doubt ([?]). The title "Mes" beginning of the last line is uncertain. The catchword and "P. j." are printed under the text block; "P. j." is treated as a signature. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
